critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3871 lines — exceeds the 700-line soft limit. Suggest splitting quota gate (lines 2820-3055) and activity logging (lines 449-548) into their own modules (quota.py, activity.py) for testability/maintainability.
Both-aspects quota refund flow correctly tracks gated_aspects as (mode, estimated_cents) tuples and refunds in order on either circuit-breaker trip OR HTTPException — clean implementation.
/api/me/quota correctly distinguishes dev_bypass/STUDIO_GRANT vs founder vs regular buyer and returns the right shape for each.
_csv_filename uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') — date-based filenames will roll over at UTC midnight, which is acceptable per the spec.
Activity log endpoint silently returns {ok: false} for disallowed types rather than 4xx — prevents leaky-UI from polluting metrics and won't surface as a user-visible error. Good design.
